dogrulama.tutmayan: FERTFAKTOR ondalık virgüllü değer sayısı (talimat: virgüllü)

hizmet_kapsami.tanim: 18+ adults with PHQ-8 >= 10 and no psychologist, psychotherapist or psychiatrist visit in the past 12 months

oncel.kural: Gün sayısı bloğunun önsel kişi arası x'b SD medyanı en büyük kategorik bloğunkinin 2 katını aşarsa gün katsayılarının ölçeği sırayla 1/SD_x ve 1/(2 SD_x) yapılır; ölçütü ilk sağlayan seçilir

model_cekilisleri.secim: unique(round(seq(1, 6000, length.out = 1000))) over the post-warm-up draws (4 chains)

kapasite.aralik: percentile 2.5–97.5, household cluster bootstrap, fixed model fits and fold assignments

M1 − M0.0.5.not: Bootstrap replicate proportions (household cluster bootstrap, B = 2,000); not posterior probabilities

M1 − M0.1.not: Bootstrap replicate proportions (household cluster bootstrap, B = 2,000); not posterior probabilities

M1 − M0.2.not: Bootstrap replicate proportions (household cluster bootstrap, B = 2,000); not posterior probabilities

M2 − M1.0.5.not: Bootstrap replicate proportions (household cluster bootstrap, B = 2,000); not posterior probabilities

M2 − M1.1.not: Bootstrap replicate proportions (household cluster bootstrap, B = 2,000); not posterior probabilities

M2 − M1.2.not: Bootstrap replicate proportions (household cluster bootstrap, B = 2,000); not posterior probabilities

kat_duzeyi.tanim: D_tavan,kat(c) = 1000 × Σ_k min(c × W_k, Σ_{i∈k} w_i y_i) / Σ_i w_i; folds of the primary (first) fold assignment
